page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.12xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores and 48 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 2.0 GB per core ratio. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong CPU capabilities, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core performance placing in the top 25%. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and cryptography standards like AES and SHA_NI. Memory bandwidth tests show strong performance for cached small-block reads at 3646.1 GB/sec, though uncached large-block reads and writes drop to average levels at 113.72 GB/sec and 83.95 GB/sec respectively. Multi-threaded decompression and database operations also rank in the top 25%, with Redis SET operations reaching 64.43 million operations per second.

Given its compute-centric 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and lack of bundled local storage, this instance offers high resource density for CPU-bound tasks without the added cost of unutilized memory or storage. It is designed for workloads such as software compilation, multi-threaded data decompression, database operations, and ray tracing, where raw processing power and vector instruction support are prioritized over large memory footprints.
